expected.fmt:
import expect_equal from "@std/test/test.ms"

test "receiver before index":
    let values = [7]
    var calls = 0
    let index: Int? = 0
    let result = values.get(
        match index:
            i:
                calls += 1
                i
            none: 0
    )
    try expect_equal(result, 7)
    try expect_equal(calls, 1)
